Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music Tiwa Savage gives Siifa’s ‘Slim Girl’ the superstar stamp of approval Source : Joy Entertainment 10 November 2026 11:41am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Afrobeats singer Siifa has received a boost to his rising career after Nigerian superstar Tiwa Savage was spotted vibing to his latest single, ‘Slim Girl.'
The moment, which has sparked conversations on social media, has brought additional attention to the emerging singer and his growing musical catalogue.
For Siifa, having a respected music icon such as Tiwa Savage connect with his sound is an encouraging development. Widely celebrated for her musical achievements and influence, Tiwa’s moment with the song represents a significant milestone for the emerging artiste.
According to Siifa, ‘SLIM GIRL’ celebrates the beauty and captivating curves of women while creating an energetic, feel-good atmosphere. He describes the track as an ideal soundtrack for dancing, entertainment and celebrating the confidence and beauty of femininity.
Beyond the attention surrounding ‘SLIM GIRL’, Siifa has continued to demonstrate his versatility through other releases. His previous single, ‘Soro’, is available on major digital streaming platforms, further expanding his catalogue.
Another notable release is ‘Leave You’, featuring Ghanaian singer Olivetheboy. The song explores the emotional experiences of a woman battling insecurity and the fear of losing her partner. In response, her lover reassures her of his genuine affection and commitment, promising not to abandon her.
Siifa’s musical journey began at a young age. He discovered his passion for singing at just 12 while participating in the choir alongside his cousin, Ifeanyi, popularly known as Ipro Boy, at Pool of Healing Church in Aba, Abia State. During his time at the church, he also developed his musical abilities by playing different instruments.
The singer draws creative inspiration from his personal experiences and the environment around him, using music as a platform to communicate relatable stories, emotions and life lessons.
His musical journey has also seen him collaborate with Ghanaian artiste FBS. Their collaboration, titled ‘Odogwu’, has gained visibility, with its official music video reportedly receiving television airplay, while the audio is available on digital streaming platforms.
A major turning point in Siifa’s career came with his signing to McNeil Musik. After years of seeking sponsorship and the right support to advance his music career, the record deal represents an important step towards achieving his professional ambitions.
With the attention surrounding ‘SLIM GIRL’ continuing to grow, Siifa is steadily positioning himself in the Afrobeats space. From his early beginnings in the church choir to collaborations with Ghanaian artistes and his latest record deal, his journey reflects his determination, consistency and passion for music.
Tiwa Savage’s moment with ‘SLIM GIRL’ has given Siifa another opportunity to introduce his sound to a wider audience.
